unit.why: A single anecdote told by the Neskhizer about his visit with his brother to the Apter Rav in Medzhybizh, where the Apter shows him through his rooms and exaggerates about burning the kvitlekh.

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר הרה״ק הנ"ל שפ"א הי' הוא
stories.end_quote: מחמת שידע דרכו בקודש : משיחותיו הקדושים.
stories.summary_en: The Neskhizer recounts how the Apter Rav led him through all his rooms (so that he would pray for the Apter's sick wife) and told him that, for fear of an informer, he had the petition-slips burned for three days straight; the Neskhizer held back laughter at the exaggeration, knowing the Apter's holy manner.

tags.why: Framed as told by the Neskhizer from his own experience

quotes: הי' הוא עם אחיו הקאוולר במעזיבוז אצל הרב מאפטא
